def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    transform_map = {1: 6, 2: 7, 3: 8, 4: 9}
    
    # Find all separator rows (rows containing 5) and columns (columns containing 5)
    sep_rows = set(r for r in range(rows) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for c in range(cols)))
    sep_cols = set(c for c in range(cols) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(rows)))
    
    # Map each region to its representative digit
    region_digit = {}
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != 5:
                # Find region boundaries
                top = max([i for i in sep_rows if i < r], default=-1)
                bottom = min([i for i in sep_rows if i > r], default=rows)
                left = max([j for j in sep_cols if j < c], default=-1)
                right = min([j for j in sep_cols if j > c], default=cols)
                
                top += 1  # Region starts after top separator
                bottom -= 1  # Region ends before bottom separator
                left += 1   # Region starts after left separator
                right -= 1  # Region ends before right separator
                
                # Use a grid reference to identify region
                if r < rows and c < cols:
                    region_key = (top, bottom, left, right)
                    if region_key not in region_digit:
                        region_digit[region_key] = grid[r][c]
    
    # Fill output grid
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 5:
                result[r][c] = 5
            else:
                # Find which region this cell belongs to
                top_sep = max([i for i in sep_rows if i < r], default=-1)
                bottom_sep = min([i for i in sep_rows if i > r], default=rows)
                left_sep = max([j for j in sep_cols if j < c], default=-1)
                right_sep = min([j for j in sep_cols if j > c], default=cols)
                
                top += 1 if sep_rows else r
                bottom -= 1 if sep_rows else rows
                left += 1 if sep_cols else c
                right -= 1 if sep_cols else cols
                
                # Transform based on region's digit
                if region_key := region_digit.get((top, bottom, left, right)):
                    result[r][c] = transform_map.get(region_key, region_key)
                else:
                    result[r][c] = 0
    
    return result
